welcome.title: Hey, I'm Gibbo!
welcome.body: Your pocket jester for Cent Companion. I'll show you around your profile — takes about thirty seconds.

standings.title: National standing
standings.body: Your points, wins, losses, and how many events you've played on the national leaderboard.

myEvents.title: Your events
myEvents.body: Tournaments you've registered for live here. When a round starts, you'll get a shortcut to pairings.

settings.title: Profile & city
settings.body: Open Settings to set your local league city — we'll surface nearby league events on the calendar.

finish.title: You're set!
finish.body: Browse events, join with a code at the venue, and check the Tournament tab on event day. I'll stay out of your way during rounds.
